svg.text: Hezsy Safety Suppliers — logo concepts, round 2
Concepts for review — pick a direction (or tell me what you like in each).
A yellow hard hat inside a bolt-head
hexagon: construction and protection in one
Your H on a shield with hazard stripes at
the base: safety first, unmistakably yours.
A bold H whose crossbar is hazard tape:
simplest, and great on vests and helmets.
